differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The entire frame is uniformly sharp with no depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field in the camera settings.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the image are significantly darker than the center, showing a strong vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners are almost as bright as the center, lacking a vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect in post-processing.

differences.a_observable: The crevices between the keys have deep, dark shadows, creating high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The crevices have light grey shadows, resulting in a flatter image.
differences.fix: Deepen the shadows and increase overall contrast.

differences.a_observable: The white surfaces and shadows have a cool blue-green tint.
differences.b_observable: The white surfaces are neutral white and grey.
differences.fix: Apply a cool color grade to the shadows and midtones.
